environment: Docker Compose local: OS + Billing + Production + PostgreSQL 16 + DynamoDB/SQS LocalStack
scenarios: Inventory facade stores catalog and additive stock exclusively in Production
Duplicate SQS commands/events preserve one reservation and one execution-release history entry
